The '''Gozanti Armed Transport''' was a model of armed [[transport]]<ref name="Ships" /> that came into service by<ref name="Outlaws" /> [[3 ABY]].<ref name="Date">{{OutlawsDate}}</ref> Gozanti Armed Transports could be spotted in orbit around [[Akiva]] during the [[Imperial Era]] and a number were used by the [[Hutt Clan]].<ref name="Outlaws" /> These starships participated in the [[Battle of Exegol]] as part of a [[Citizens' Fleet]]<ref name="Lando DB" /> of volunteer civilians from across the galaxy gathered by former [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] [[General]] [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]], which took up arms to assist in the defeat of the resurgent [[Galactic Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious]] and the [[Sith Eternal]]'s attempt at [[Galaxy|galactic]] domination.<ref name="Episode IX" />
